queries.label: F01_E1
queries.sql:
SELECT *, (REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(CONCAT(IFNULL(title_en,''),' ',IFNULL(abstract_en,''))), @ctx_en) OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(CONCAT(IFNULL(title_ko,''),' ',IFNULL(abstract_ko,'')), @ctx_ko)) AS hit_context, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(ARRAY_CONCAT(cpc_codes, ipc_codes)) c, UNNEST(@F01_E1_cpc) p WHERE STARTS_WITH(c, p)) AS hit_cpc
FROM `idyllic-coder-510805-s5.patents_work.pat_candidates`
WHERE (REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(CONCAT(IFNULL(title_en,''),' ',IFNULL(abstract_en,''))), @F01_E1_b0_en) OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(CONCAT(IFNULL(title_ko,''),' ',IFNULL(abstract_ko,'')), @F01_E1_b0_ko)) AND (REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(CONCAT(IFNULL(title_en,''),' ',IFNULL(abstract_en,''))), @F01_E1_b1_en) OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(CONCAT(IFNULL(title_ko,''),' ',IFNULL(abstract_ko,'')), @F01_E1_b1_ko))
  AND ((REGEXP_CONTAINS(LOWER(CONCAT(IFNULL(title_en,''),' ',IFNULL(abstract_en,''))), @ctx_en) OR REGEXP_CONTAINS(CONCAT(IFNULL(title_ko,''),' ',IFNULL(abstract_ko,'')), @ctx_ko)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(ARRAY_CONCAT(cpc_codes, ipc_codes)) c, UNNEST(@F01_E1_cpc) p WHERE STARTS_WITH(c, p)))
